info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v1-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the list of fitness membership classes available for users. It enables fitness centers and applications to retrieve detailed information about the classes, including schedules, types, and availability. Typical consumers of this API include fitness center management systems, mobile applications for fitness enthusiasts, and user dashboard integrations. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can create tailored experiences for users seeking to explore and enroll in fitness membership classes.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of classes associated with memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all classes that are available under the membership offerings. Suitable for users looking to explore different class options tied to their membership plans.
